definitions.gloss: electronic money; e-money; digital payment method
definitions.explanation: Digital currency or payment systems that allow transactions without physical cash. Includes prepaid IC cards, mobile payment apps, and other cashless payment methods.

examples.japanese: {電子|でんし}マネー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}えます→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can I pay with electronic money?

examples.english: To add money to an e-money card.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{電子|でんし}マネー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Lately I use electronic money more than cash.

notes:
FORMATION:
⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧ (electronic) + ⟦マネー→マネー：29549_manee⟧ (money).

WHAT IT COVERS:
Prepaid transport IC cards (Suica, PASMO, ICOCA), retailer cards (nanaco, WAON), and smartphone payment apps (PayPay, LINE Pay, {楽天|らくてん}ペイ). Transport cards are accepted in convenience stores and vending machines as well as at ticket gates, so in ordinary conversation {電子|でんし}マネー usually means tapping a card or phone at a till rather than an online transfer.

COLLOCATIONS:

- {電子|でんし}マネー⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ — accepts e-money (the wording on shop signs)
